Scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 跟妈妈：妈妈带着他，This wording means that 孟子 moved together with his mother. When the mother takes her child to relocate, use 带着孟子搬家. [vocab list]
Run 2: 跟妈妈搬家：妈妈带着他搬家，The mother is the person who takes the child to move; 带着孟子搬家 expresses this relationship more accurately. [vocab list]
Run 3: Coherence (Temporality): 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，This is one completed move at age five, so the completed action needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

output.reason: Runs 1 and 2 recast the mother as the agent of the move, whereas Run 3 only adds 了 for completion.
